scope: Tracker suppliers with structured SEC XBRL quarterly revenue (edgarId in edgarRegistry). Set by source class before results are known (D-89). Derived, never hand-set: a test fails if this list differs from the derived set.
policy: Every certified supplier and group is required. Each claim is re-derived from primary SEC data by a verifier that shares no code with the producer; it applies the same XBRL rules (quarter and year durations, latest-filed restatement, newest-concept selection), so it is a reproducibility check against SEC data, not a second methodology. The gate re-derives claims from the build inputs and refuses any drift. A failed source or mismatch yields no proof and holds the run. No exclusions or disclosure answers without an explicit reviewed entry. Displayed fields outside certification are listed in notCertified.

notCertified.headlineMetric: ARR, cRPO, billings and similar figures that companies state themselves. They are not in structured SEC data.
notCertified.ownership: Free-text descriptions. The name, ticker and listing status are certified instead.
notCertified.events without an sec.gov source: Shown with the source that reported them.
notCertified.event text: For SEC events the filing, its date and the event type are certified. The written summary of a hand-collected event is not.
notCertified.growthBasis: Shown only for Trend Micro, which does not file with the SEC.

componentNotes.priorYearValue: Not a required component, because a newly public filer has no prior-year quarter. When displayed it is verified against SEC and covered by the gate's drift check on every leaf.
